title: Lead with a position
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What responsibility do you have to the people who look to you?

Think of it this way, I said: I'm a director in a school, and I'm reading about this. What responsibility do I have to those kids in the classroom? Am I going to help children understand AI and its negative consequences, or say that's not my responsibility?

A student said: that is your responsibility. If you are responsible for what happens to them at home, why stop there? I said: education has to keep up with technology, because the medium is going to affect the outcome.

A student said: we are the cornerstone of innovation for our communities. We have to take up the leadership responsibility of informing people on the changes and guiding them. People are looking to us.

I said there are massive opportunities in this. Schools need to take a stance, governments need to take a stance, and as leaders and entrepreneurs we have to say: this is my position. My position can evolve.
A student said: we need to encourage everyone to develop a position. I said: that is what I am trying to do. Being a leader is being aware and helping people to be aware.

A student said: there is a beauty in doing it yourself, and a surety that it's being done. A very underrated element of leadership is service: being a servant leader, whether a parent or anything else. Encouraging those you lead to serve makes them leaders.
I said: don't wait, do it yourself. People say: I don't have enough money. If you don't have enough money, you have plenty of time and energy.
When I first talk to a company, I said, I get into what their values are. Their core values.
What is your position on AI, and when will you say it to your team?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the people who look to you.
Write what you owe them about changes you can see coming.
Write your position on AI, and how it may evolve.
Write one thing you will do yourself instead of waiting.

check.q: What did I say about my position as a leader?
What did a student say about entrepreneurs?
choices: They are the cornerstone of innovation for their communities

check.q: What did I say you have plenty of if you lack money?

recap: Lead with a position that can evolve. Serve. Do it yourself.
